en: Colorized historic postcard showing a large metal Roland statue in armor standing against the wall of a building on a cobblestone square. The statue holds a long staff or lance and is chained to low posts. In the background are small town houses with red tiled roofs; one bears the sign "Wilhelm Müller." A solitary man in early 20th‑century clothing walks across the square. Printed German text at the top identifies the location and the statue.
